reason: PyTorch returned torch._C._CUuuid for device properties.uuid. The probe accepted only bytes or str and rejected the canonical UUID-bearing object before physics stepping evidence could be emitted.
fix_summary: Normalize PyTorch str, bytes, or _CUuuid values only when their textual form is a canonical UUID; add the NVIDIA GPU- prefix and compare with the frozen expected UUID. Arbitrary objects and malformed values remain fail-closed.
authorization_basis: User authorized GPU use and directed same-class environment/output compatibility defects to be fixed and continued without repeated permission requests; the failed attempt remains preserved and is not overwritten.
